findings.title: Structured data is already an established foundation

source.title: AI-Focused Shopify SEO Agency | SEOasis
source.note: Inspected downloaded public HTML: 10 JSON-LD blocks, Organization, WebSite, ProfessionalService, reviews, breadcrumb, videos, Person and HowTo.

findings.evidence: Representative homepage, service, hub, article and case-study templates contain JSON-LD. All detected blocks in the 20-page public sample parsed as JSON.
findings.purpose: Maintain template consistency and prevent regressions
findings.action: Build a template QA checklist before recommending new schema.

findings.title: Review video contentUrl values

source.title: AI-Focused Shopify SEO Agency | SEOasis
source.note: Inspected downloaded public HTML: 10 JSON-LD blocks, Organization, WebSite, ProfessionalService, reviews, breadcrumb, videos, Person and HowTo.

findings.evidence: Homepage VideoObject contentUrl values end in .jsonp while embedUrl identifies Wistia players. Google documents contentUrl as actual video bytes; response contents were not independently fetched.
findings.action: Validate media endpoints and use a verified playable file URL, or rely on correct embedUrl when unavailable.

guidelineSource.title: VideoObject Schema Markup | Google Search Central
guidelineSource.note: contentUrl should point to actual video bytes; embedUrl can identify the specific player.

findings.title: Keep testimonial proof distinct from review-star eligibility

source.title: AI-Focused Shopify SEO Agency | SEOasis
source.note: Inspected downloaded public HTML: 10 JSON-LD blocks, Organization, WebSite, ProfessionalService, reviews, breadcrumb, videos, Person and HowTo.

findings.evidence: Homepage ProfessionalService nests AggregateRating and three Reviews about SEOasis. Google excludes self-serving reviews for Organization/LocalBusiness types from review stars; authenticity of testimonials has not been independently verified.
findings.action: Confirm visible testimonial accuracy and provenance; do not use this markup as a forecast of review stars.

guidelineSource.title: Review Snippet Structured Data | Google Search Central
guidelineSource.note: Self-serving Organization/LocalBusiness reviews are not eligible for review stars; markup must accurately represent visible content.

findings.title: FAQPage is present; do not forecast Google FAQ rich results

validationWorkflow: Match every entity, price, review, date and answer to visible current facts.
Parse JSON; check entity IDs and schema vocabulary with Schema Markup Validator.
Run Rich Results Test for supported Google features and archive results.
Check rendered HTML, canonical and access in Search Console URL Inspection — Requires Internal Access.
Monitor enhancements and performance by template; recheck after releases.

internalData.evidence: Public initial HTML cannot establish what Google indexed or whether enhancements are eligible.

internalData.decision: Fix template defects, release or monitor

guardrails: No special AI schema required; schema does not guarantee AI citation.
Never invent ratings, reviews, authors, prices, dates or product facts.
Do not blanket apply Product to collection pages or agency service pages.
Do not promise FAQ, HowTo, Speakable or Service rich results from observed markup.
